score: COMPOSER: the score for this film

Design the music for this 59.3 s film. The owner liked a past score with REAL MELODY AND FEELING: a tune a viewer can hum after one listen, mainly FELT PIANO and a solo CELLO, music that drops nearly out under the key line. The music must sit UNDER the narration (and under two short KJV lines, which must be heard clean). Story idea to honour: a promise spoken 700 years early -> kept in Bethlehem -> the experts who knew did NOT go, the far-away wise men DID go -> but Jesus came much farther (heaven, cross, risen) -> 'Before anyone went to Him, He came to us.' Give the music a clear shape tied to the promise idea, say exactly where it lifts, where it drops out (there is a 1 s planned pause before 'The Bible never says the experts went'), and what plays in the final hold.
